contract.arithmetic: Decimal, context precision 50; all displayed comparisons quantize(0.01, ROUND_HALF_UP); source-precision comparisons quantize(1E-10)
contract.event_reference: ref = (prev_close - C1/10 + C4*C2/10) / ((10+C3+C4)/10); displayed 昨结口径 = ref_cent = quantize(ref, 0.01, ROUND_HALF_UP); prev_close = raw .day close of the bar immediately before the event

field_roles.C1: 每10股派现(元,含税) — bound by #167 F10 displays
field_roles.C2: 配股价(元) — bound by #167 F10 display
field_roles.C3: 每10股送转数 — INDIRECT: role constrained only via 000002 multi-event chain behavior; caveat must remain
field_roles.C4: 每10股配股数 — bound by #167 F10 display (stored 2.727 vs displayed 2.73)

contract.input_normalization: each C field: float32 -> Decimal(str(float(Decimal(exact_binary_string)))) -> quantize(0.01, ROUND_HALF_UP); exact-binary f32 tails excluded
contract.qfq_chain: front-adjustment for a bar at date d = affine composition over events with event_date > d, accumulated oldest->newest: A=A/s, B=(B-d_+a_)/s with d_=C1/10, a_=C4*C2/10, s=(10+C3+C4)/10; NO intermediate cent rounding; anchored at latest bar
